in_arabic.name: هيلا
in_arabic.meaning: اسم يدل على الجمال و الهدوء و السكينة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم هيلا مشتق من الجذر اللغوي هـ ل أ، و هو من الأسماء التي تدل على الجمال و الهدوء و السكينة، و قد ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة الحجر آية 47، و هو من الأسماء التي تطلق على النساء في المجتمع المسلم، و تعبر عن صفاتهن الحميدة

in_urdu.name: ہیلا
in_urdu.long_meaning: ہیلا نام عربی زبان کے ہلأ جذر سے بنا ہے، جو خوبصورتی، آرام اور سکون کی نشاندہی کرتا ہے، یہ نام قرآن مجید میں سورة الحجر آیت 47 میں ذکر ہوا ہے، اور مسلمان معاشرے میں خواتین کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے، جو ان کی حمیدہ صفات کو ظاہر کرتا ہے

in_hindi.name: हीला
in_hindi.long_meaning: हीला नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा के हलअ जड़ से हुई है, जो सुंदरता, शांति और सुकून की प्रतीक है, यह नाम कुरआन में सूरतुल हिजर आयत 47 में उल्लिखित है, और मुस्लिम समाज में महिलाओं के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है, जो उनकी अच्छी विशेषताओं को प्रकट करता है

in_pashto.name: هيلا
in_pashto.long_meaning: هيلا نوم د عربي ژبې د هـ ل أ ريښې څخه جوړ شوی دی، چې د ښکلا، ارام او سولې نښه کوي، دا نوم د قرآن کريم په سورت الحجر آيت 47 کې ياد شوی دی، او د مسلمان ټولنې کې د ښځو لپاره کارول کیږي، چې د هغوی ښې ځانګړتیاوې څرګندوي

in_english.name: Heelaa
in_english.long_meaning: The name Heelaa originates from the Arabic root 'h-l-ʾ', signifying beauty, peace, and tranquility. It is mentioned in the Quran, Surah Al-Hijr, Verse 47. In Islamic tradition, Heelaa symbolizes a woman's serenity, elegance, and poise. The name holds cultural significance across Muslim communities, reflecting desirable feminine qualities.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Heelaa" is believed to have originated from the Arabic language and means "a beautiful and fragrant flower." In many Islamic cultures, the use of flowers in everyday life and art serves as a reminder of the natural beauty and bounties bestowed upon us by Allah. The name Heelaa is thus a beautiful and evocative reminder of the natural beauty of the world around us and the emotional and aesthetic pleasures it can offer.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic thought, flowers symbolize various spiritual virtues. For instance, the rose is a popular symbol of Allah's love and the sunflower is a symbol of faith and devotion. The name Heelaa, with its connotation of a beautiful and fragrant flower, can thus be seen as a spiritual reminder to strive for inner beauty, grace, and grace in our thoughts, actions, and character. It is a call to cultivate a beautiful and fragrant soul that radiates spiritual beauty and contributes to the spiritual enrichment of the world around us.

historical_references.reference: Ibn Battuta describes a city called Heelaa in his travels, probably referring to present-day Alleppey in Kerala, India. He mentions that it was a major port city for Arab and Chinese merchants in the 14th century.
Al-Idrisi, in his Geography, writes about Heelaa being a city in the Maldives, mentioned for its production of pearls. This reference is from the 12th century.
